payload.summary: The council's equality impact assessment of the draft policy, completed on 30 January 2026 by the Licensing Team Leader and signed off by the executive director for climate and environment. It records positive effects for children and young people, for women and girls, and for people at risk of harassment in late-night venues because of their race, sexual orientation or gender identity, and it identifies no adverse effects. All wards are marked as affected. The council says the assessment will be updated once the consultation results come back to committee.
